name: fitvr-platform
description: Fit.VR B2B virtual fitting SaaS for gym apparel, athleisure, and performance wear brands.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @fitvr/shared run build && npm --workspace @fitvr/sdk run build && npm --workspace @fitvr/api run build && npm --workspace @fitvr/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace @fitvr/web run test && npm --workspace @fitvr/api run test
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @fitvr/shared run build && npm --workspace @fitvr/web run lint && npm --workspace @fitvr/api run lint
